#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

const double PI = acos(-1.0);

double get_angle(const vector<int>& p1, const vector<int>& p2, const vector<int>& p3) {
    double dot = 0, aLen = 0, bLen = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        dot += (p2[i] - p1[i]) * (p3[i] - p1[i]);
        aLen += (p2[i] - p1[i]) * (p2[i] - p1[i]);
        bLen += (p3[i] - p1[i]) * (p3[i] - p1[i]);
    }
    return 180.0 * acos(dot / sqrt(aLen * bLen)) / PI;
}

int readInt() {
    int ret = 0, c;
    while ((c = getchar()) <= ' ') {}
    bool neg = false;
    if (c == '-') {
        neg = true;
        c = getchar();
    }
    do {
        ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
    } while ((c = getchar()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
    if (neg) return -ret;
    return ret;
}

int main() {
    int n = readInt();
    if (n > 20) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<vector<int>> p(n, vector<int>(5));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
            p[i][j] = readInt();
        }
    }
    vector<int> good;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool good_flag = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && good_flag; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            for (int k = j + 1; k < n && good_flag; k++) {
                if (i == k) continue;
                double angle = get_angle(p[i], p[j], p[k]);
                if (angle < 90.0) {
                    good_flag = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (good_flag) good.push_back(i + 1);
    }
    cout << good.size() << endl;
    for (int idx : good) {
        cout << idx << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
